title: Nasty Liq Gummy Bear 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Return to the sweetshop with Nasty Liq's Gummy Bear, an e-liquid that masterfully captures the beloved chewy treats of yesteryear. Upon inhaling, you're immediately met with the luscious sweetness of ripe pineapple—a sunshine-soaked flavour that conjures images of tropical bliss. This bright pineapple note is quickly enveloped by a vibrant mix of berries, delivering a tart counterbalance that echoes the multifaceted taste of those delectable gummy candies. The interplay of pineapple and berry flavours is not just delicious; it's reminiscent of the joy and simplicity of childhood yet refined enough to appeal to your grown-up palate. Each inhale is like delving into a bag of your favourite candies, without the stickiness on your fingers, but with all the flavour in your mouth. The magic of this e-liquid doesn't end with its flavour. Its 50VG/50PG blend promises a vape that's as smooth as it is satisfying, with the perfect amount of cloud production to complement the rich, full-bodied taste. The nic salt formulation adds to the experience, ensuring every draw is as smooth on the throat as it is exciting for the tastebuds. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
